_comment: Maryland 2026 thresholds: Chapter 3 of the Multifamily Rental Financing Program Guide. One row per requirement subsection. 3.7 (RHFP and RHW loan terms) is financing terms, not a pass/fail test, and is not coded. The table of contents numbers Amortizing Loans 3.7.8; the body numbers it 3.7.6.
